important_dates.interview_date: 18th of every month (or next working day if the 18th is a holiday), 11:00 AM onwards

application_fee.details: The fee, once paid, is non-refundable under any circumstances.

Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

qualification.details: Educational qualification for all posts is as per National Medical Commission (NMC, erstwhile MCI) guidelines. The notification does not list post-wise/department-wise qualification details (such as specific MD/MS/DNB requirements or years of experience) beyond this reference; candidates should verify their specific eligibility against NMC norms for their department and post before applying. | The maximum tenure of engagement will extend till 70 years of age for teaching faculty, or the contract period, whichever is earlier, subject to other rules being satisfied. | Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date. | Retired as well as currently working Professors may also apply for eligible posts. Any candidate can be appointed against an unfilled, vacant reserved-category post for 44 days, with a provision for possible extension if required. EWS candidates must submit an EWS certificate as per the prescribed DoPT format (Annexure-I). OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificates must be issued not earlier than one year before the date of interview, in the Central Government format. All candidates must hold updated Medical Registration (NMC/State Medical Council); if not yet updated, proof of "applied for" documents must be submitted at the time of interview.

salary_details.details: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated remuneration as per ESIC Headquarters orders, comprising basic pay plus applicable allowances (NPA at 20% where applicable, Dearness Allowance at 60%, House Rent Allowance at 20%, and Travel Allowance of ₹7,200 plus DA thereon), as prevailing on date. These rates are subject to revision as per Headquarters instructions issued from time to time. | Basic pay will be revised automatically whenever the Dearness Allowance rate changes; however, arrears will not be admissible with retrospective effect.

selection_process: Selection is made on the basis of acquired academic credentials and the candidate's performance in a personal interview before the Selection Board. No written examination is mentioned in the notification. Results will be displayed in the Recruitments section of www.esic.gov.in. Offer of Appointment will be sent through e-mail only. Opportunity to interview is provisional
subject to detailed scrutiny of eligibility criteria.
how_to_apply: The mode of interview is offline; there is no online application portal mentioned in the notification. The application process has two stages:

Email submission: Eligible candidates must send a scanned copy of the completed Application Form, Demand Draft (if applicable), and all required supporting documents (including proof of research publications and conference papers, if any) to [email protected], by 4:00 PM of the 15th of every month (or the next working day if the 15th is a holiday). The e-mail subject line must mention the candidate's Name, Post, and Department.

Physical submission: The original Application Form, self-attested supporting documents, and original Demand Draft (as interview fee, if applicable) must reach The Dean, ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Nanda Nagar, Indore (M.P.) – 452011, on or before the 17th of every month (i.e., before the interview date). The envelope must be marked: "Recruitment of Teaching Faculty/Senior Residents on contract basis" along with the Name of Post and Department.
Candidates must then report in person for the walk-in interview on the 18th of every month (or the next working day if the 18th is a holiday), between 9:00 AM and 11:00 AM.
Class 10th certificate (for date of birth)
All mark sheets, attempt details, and degree certificate of MBBS
All mark sheets, attempt details, and degree certificate of MD/MS/DNB or other relevant examination
Valid EWS/OBC/SC/ST/PwD certificate (Central Government format), if applicable
State/NMC Medical Registration Certificate (updated)
Proof of publications
Experience certificate
Recent passport-size photograph
Relieving/NOC certificate from previous or current employer, if applicable
Aadhaar Card
ICMR/NMC bio-medical research examination completion certificate, if any
NMC Revised/Basic Medical Education Workshop completion certificate, if any

All original documents will be verified before the interview. A separate application must be submitted for each post, in the prescribed format only; applications in any other format, or incomplete applications, will be summarily rejected.
Tenure: 1 year, or until joining of a regular incumbent, or attainment of 70 years of age - whichever is earliest.
Either side may terminate the engagement with one month's prior notice; spot resignation requires depositing one month's salary to the ESI account.
No service benefits such as PF, Pension, Gratuity, or Medical Benefits are admissible, as this is a contractual appointment.
2.5 days of leave are credited per completed month; no other leave types are permitted.
Selected candidates must deposit a security amount of ₹20,000, forfeited if they resign or are terminated within six months of joining.
Candidates involved in patient care must hold a professional indemnity policy for the contract period, with minimum sum assured ranging from ₹10 lakh to ₹30 lakh depending on department.
No private practice is permitted in any capacity after joining.
No TA/DA is paid for appearing in the interview.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Indore Teaching Faculty & Senior Resident Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Educational qualification for all posts is as per National Medical Commission (NMC, erstwhile MCI) guidelines . The notification does not list post-wise/department-wise qualification details (such as specific MD/MS/DNB requirements or years of experience) beyond this reference; candidates should verify their specific eligibility against NMC norms for their department and post before applying. The maximum tenure of engagement will extend till 70 years of age for teaching faculty, or the contract period, whichever is earlier, subject to other rules being satisfied. Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date. Retired as well as currently working Professors may also apply for eligible posts. Any candidate can be appointed against an unfilled, vacant reserved-category post for 44 days, with a provision for possible extension if required. EWS candidates must submit an EWS certificate as per the prescribed DoPT format (Annexure-I). OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificates must be issued not earlier than one year before the date of interview, in the Central Government format. All candidates must hold updated Medical Registration (NMC/State Medical Council); if not yet updated, proof of "applied for" documents must be submitted at the time of interview.

rows.maximum_age: Not exceeding 45 years (age relaxation as per prevailing Government of India norms)

faq.question: Q1. What is ESIC Indore Teaching Faculty & Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a rolling monthly recruitment drive by ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Indore (M.P.) to fill Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, and Senior Resident posts on a contract basis, through walk-in interviews held on the 18th of every month.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in ESIC Indore Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 89 posts are notified across 24 departments: 19 Professor, 27 Associate Professor, 11 Assistant Professor, and 32 Senior Resident posts. These numbers are provisional and may change.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for ESIC Indore Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Scanned applications must reach [email protected] by 4:00 PM on the 15th of every month (or the next working day if the 15th is a holiday). This cycle repeats monthly.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for ESIC Indore Teaching Faculty posts?
faq.answer: Educational qualification is as per National Medical Commission (NMC, erstwhile MCI) guidelines. The notification does not specify further department-wise qualification details.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for ESIC Indore Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Not exceeding 69 years for Professor/Associate Professor/Assistant Professor posts, and not exceeding 45 years for Senior Resident posts, as on the 15th of every month, with age relaxation as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for ESIC Indore Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: ₹500 for general category candidates, payable via Demand Draft in favour of "ESI Fund A/c No.-1" at Indore. SC/ST/ESIC regular employees/Defence Ex-servicemen/PwD candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for ESIC Indore Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications are accepted offline. Candidates must first e-mail a scanned application form and documents to [email protected] by the 15th of the month, then submit original documents by post/hand to the Dean's office by the 17th, and finally attend the walk-in interview on the 18th.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for ESIC Indore Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on the candidate's academic credentials and performance in an interview before the Selection Board. No written exam is mentioned.
